article.title: Right to legal representation.
article.content: The appellant may either appear in person or authorise one or more legal practitioners or any of its officers to present his or its case before the 1[Appellate Tribunal].
article.html:
59Right to legal representation.

Section 59 · Chapter X · page 23 of the Act

The appellant may either appear in person or authorise one or more legal practitioners or any of its officers to present his or its case before the 1[Appellate Tribunal].

1 Subs. by 7 of 2017, s. 169, for “Cyber Appellate Tribunal” (w.e.f. 26-5-2017).
